must_not: Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

steps.action: Read the card and tap 'Save the backup file'
user_sees: 'One file with your workouts, routines in their order…'
'Your phone number and your gym membership are never in the file.'
The button counts 'Saving 37 of 210 photos…'
must_not: The button tappable twice
A frozen count

steps.action: Pick Files in the share sheet titled 'Download my data'
user_sees: A buzz and a line naming the file, its size, the workouts and photos in it, and any photos left out
must_not: A success line when photos were left out without saying so
Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

note: The progress words sit inside the button
